description: super-reprompt: H1 suggests framing a large request (one line, never blocks), H2 re-injects a short mission reminder after compaction or resume, H3 gates the end of an executing mission. All three fail open and stay silent unless relevant. Set SUPER_REPROMPT_HOOKS=0 to turn them off. L4: the PreToolUse firewall (guard.py) is silent unless a mission has been sealed (SCELLE.json); inside a sealed mission it fails CLOSED (exit 2).

hooks.command: PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -n "$PY" ]; then exec "$PY" -I -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py"; else exec py -3 -I -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py"; fi
